name: Heatseeker
description: Chat with AI personas trained on real customer behavior, monitor live ad performance, and check experiment results, directly from Claude. Heatseeker is the customer intelligence layer for modern marketing teams: AI personas and live market experiments that give you real buyer signal in days, not months. Bring proof into your Claude workflow so your next decision is grounded in customer behavior, not opinion.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Heatseeker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Heatseeker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.heatseeker.ai/mcp/heatseeker. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Heatseeker MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heatseeker lists 13 MCP tools, including callDataAnalyst, callHeatseekerAIAgent, chatWithPersonaAgent, createAudienceDraft, createExperimentDraft, getAllExperiments, getExperimentDraft, getTopAds, getWorkspaceCatalog, listExperimentDrafts, listPersonas, and searchCampaignHistory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Heatseeker?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Heatseeker in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Heatseeker requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Heatseeker is developed by Heatseeker. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
